invariant: Each header/footer body line creates a stripe, including leading blank lines. Selected font family determines both line height and width; significant monospace spaces survive SVG serialization.
causal_divergence: String emptiness is used as a line count so leading blank stripes collapse. Width uses selected family but height/advance use sans-serif.
planned_change: Track ribbon body line presence independently of text length and use existing family-aware text metrics for block height/advance and nonbreaking spaces for monospace output. No shared font changes.
perturbation_axes: Serif/monospace/default families crossed with sizes and alignment
verification_plan: Preserved checker references, targeted source-guided controls, final frozen scopes and both main tiers; independent acceptance remains outstanding.
